## About
Summit West Contracting is a roofing and siding contractor based on Zenobia Loop in Westminster. We work on the outside of your house: the roof over your head and the siding that keeps the weather out.
John, the owner, likes to keep things straightforward. Customers tell us they appreciate knowing the process, the cost and the materials up front, and hearing from us as the work moves along. If you only need a repair, we'll fix what needs fixing and leave it at that.
We're rated 5 stars from 157 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to talk through your project with you.

## Services
- Roofing: Roof work for homes in the Westminster area, with each step of the project explained as we go.
- Siding: New siding work for your home, with clear communication from start to finish.
- Siding repairs: If only part of your siding needs attention, we repair what's needed without adding extras you don't.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do both roofing and siding on the same house?
A: Yes. One customer had both their siding and roof done with us.

Q: Will I know what the job involves before you start?
A: We go over the process, the cost and the materials needed so you know what to expect.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
